verdict.rationale: The xAI API lets you create API keys self-serve (grok-supp-api-keys) and manage teams through a Management API (grok-docs-40). The only limited credential documented is the short-lived ephemeral token, which is meant for client-side Speech to Speech connections rather than general agent use (grok-docs-39). Missing for 10: documented per-key scopes or permission restrictions (e.g., limiting a key to specific endpoints or models), programmatic issuance of restricted keys via the Management API, per-key spend or rate caps for agents, and any independent or hands-on confirmation.
